def market_breadth_daily(panel: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Partial GP market-regime input from Daily data only.
    This DOES NOT claim to be the full three-state regime because yesterday-limit-up performance
    and first-30-minute volume require extra datasets.
    """
    x=panel.copy()
    active=~x["ex_suspended"].astype(bool)
    rows=[]
    for d,g0 in x[active].groupby("date"):
        g=g0[g0["ret_d1"].notna()]
        ge=g[g["eligible"]]
        adv_all=int((g["ret_d1"]>0).sum()); dec_all=int((g["ret_d1"]<0).sum()); flat_all=int((g["ret_d1"]==0).sum())
        adv_el=int((ge["ret_d1"]>0).sum()); dec_el=int((ge["ret_d1"]<0).sum())
        if adv_all>3000: adv_state="HOT"
        elif adv_all>=1000: adv_state="NEUTRAL"
        else: adv_state="COLD"
        rows.append({"date":d,"active_all":len(g),"adv_all":adv_all,"dec_all":dec_all,"flat_all":flat_all,"adv_ratio_all":adv_all/max(1,adv_all+dec_all),"eligible_n":len(ge),"adv_eligible":adv_el,"dec_eligible":dec_el,"adv_ratio_eligible":adv_el/max(1,adv_el+dec_el),"median_ret_all":g["ret_d1"].median(),"advancer_state_partial":adv_state})
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)

exact_semantics.return_observation_filter: within active rows, retain ret_d1 not null
exact_semantics.eligible_universe: subset of observed active rows where eligible is true
exact_semantics.adv_ratio_all: adv_all / max(1, adv_all + dec_all); flat excluded from denominator
exact_semantics.median_ret_all: median ret_d1 in observed active universe
exact_semantics.advancer_state_partial: HOT if adv_all>3000; NEUTRAL if adv_all>=1000; otherwise COLD
